claude_proposed_widenings.name: expire -> descend_on_end
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic_item activation family, charge_pool resource, dawn reset, and grant_speed atom cover the item's main activation, but the surface has no honest way to attach a deterministic movement consequence to duration expiry. The missing piece is an expiry-linked effect subgraph, likely realized with the v4-era fall/descent effect plus a surface hook from Duration expiry.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you are flying when the duration expires, you descend at a rate of 30 feet per round until you land.
